title: Quietly Aerated Slovakian Fromage Fres Pudding
description: A sweet and aerated post-workout Slovakian dish featuring fromage frais, nuka-pickle, and buddhist-temple-friendly ingredients, perfect for a healthy dessert or snack. This pudding is made with natural ingredients and is free from animal products.
instructions: In a blender, combine fromage frais, nuka pickle, maple syrup, and vanilla extract and blend until smooth.
In a saucepan, whisk together soy milk, agar agar powder, and lemon juice.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Fold the soy milk mixture into the fromage frais mixture until well combined.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups.
Refrigerate the pudding for at least 2 hours to allow it to set.
Once set, use a fork to gently aerate the pudding.
Serve the pudding chilled and enjoy.
